items.item: There is no greeting or hero; the header has a title and a date-range control
items.evidence: header h1 'Operations overview', no greeting or hero. Control #range with 7d/14d buttons (plus a site select). The date is only static subtitle text. Caveat: the range control only redraws the trend chart (drawTrend); KPIs and other widgets ignore it.

items.item: Each KPI tile shows label, value and a signed change with its comparison period, without decorative icon tiles
items.evidence: #kpis tiles: label 'Orders shipped today', value '13,640' (tabular-nums), '▲ +3.2% vs. yesterday', '▼ -8.1% vs. yesterday'. Sign plus arrow, no icon tiles. Only small data sparklines. Some deltas ('+4', '+212') are signed but the unit is implicit.

items.item: Charts use bars for comparison and lines for trends; no pie, donut or gauge; axes have labels and units
items.evidence: The trend chart uses lines, and zone utilization uses horizontal bars with no pie, donut or gauge. But the axes have no axis titles or units: y ticks are bare '4k', '8k', '12k', '16k' (the title says 'Orders', the aria-label says 'units'), and x ticks are '10/29'. Only legend swatches name the series.

items.item: A needs-attention list links to pre-filtered list pages
items.evidence: #alerts items render '<button class="text-sm text-blue-700">Re-slot</button>' and similar with no href or navigation. The All/Critical/Warning filter buttons only filter in-page (drawAlerts) and link nowhere.

items.item: Numbers use locale formatting and tabular figures
items.evidence: The tooltip uses s[i].toLocaleString(). KPI values, zone percentages and dock ETAs have the 'tabular-nums' class, and the rendered output shows thousands separators. Weakness: KPI values are hardcoded en-US strings, not formatted at runtime. Axis ticks, deltas and alert text are not tabular.

items.item: Each widget has loading and empty states
items.evidence: No skeleton, spinner, loading flag or empty-state markup anywhere. kpis, zones, alerts and docks are filled synchronously from constants. An empty alerts filter would render an empty <ul>.

notes: Dark slate-900 sidebar with a blue active state and red/amber/green/blue status pills (dock schedule, alert severity, zone bar colours). No greeting, gradients, glass, emoji, tracked uppercase, hover lift, oversized radius or icon tiles (radii 4-8px). Sparklines on every KPI are data-driven, so not counted as decorative-chart. Audit score 90 with one violation: text-contrast x9 (text-slate-400 'vs. yesterday' at 2.56:1, sidebar subtitle at 3.75:1). The trend chart is labelled 'Orders' but plots units. Needs-attention is a strong list with severity, location and age, but the actions are dead buttons.
